title: Anakin Skywalker
description: Anakin Skywalker trained as a Jedi under Obi-Wan Kenobi and became a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. He went on many missions with his Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, during the conflict, and just as many with his old master as well, gallivanting across the galaxy working to keep it in balance. His travels took him to many systems, from Geonosis to Mandalore and all points in between. A hero of the war, he discovered it was overseen by a Sith Lord, which led to his own downfall.
